description: This circular walk explores the countryside surrounding the Herefordshire settlements of Brampton Abbotts and Hole in the Wall. The walk includes a section along the Wye Valley Walk with some fine views over the River Wye. The route begins in Brampton Abbots and runs for just under 5 miles. It is mostly fairly flat with small climbs on the way. The route is located just north of Ross-on-Wye where you can pick up the Ross Round to continue your walking. You could also head west to pick up the Hoarwithy and King's Caple Circular Walk .
